summary: Feature request to publish RBI (Ruby Behavior Interface) types for the Temporal Ruby SDK for use with Sorbet, including argument and return types, instead of relying on tapioca.
userImpact: Ruby developers using Sorbet static type checker would have better IDE support and type safety when using the Temporal SDK.
proposedFix: Published RBI types for use with Sorbet that include argument and return types.
workaround: Users can currently rely on tapioca for generating RBIs, though it has limited usefulness outside of method discovery and arity.
keyQuote: Currently users must rely on tapioca for generating RBIs for the `temporalio` gem which isn't especially useful outside of method discovery and arity.
